_metadata.notes: Discord monitoring channels. Populate server_id and channel ids after manually joining servers. Bot must be invited to each server via OAuth2 URL.
_metadata.sources: Gemini audit + independent web research (CoinGape, CoinBureau, Whop, DISBOARD, discord.me)

_candidate_servers_tier1.name: Axion Crypto-Community
_candidate_servers_tier1.d2_relevance: Very High — Binance-specific altcoin signals, massive retail, calls can themselves cause volume spikes on low-liquidity pairs
_candidate_servers_tier1.notes: Strict moderation (2FA, DMs off). Confirmed across 5+ independent sources.

_candidate_servers_tier1.name: Filthy Rich Futures
_candidate_servers_tier1.d2_relevance: Very High — dedicated to high-leverage Binance futures, perfectly aligned with D2's USDT-M perps universe

_candidate_servers_tier1.name: DISBOARD Pump Servers (category)
_candidate_servers_tier1.d2_relevance: Very High — actual pump-and-dump coordination servers. Announce coin + time, members pile in. Leading indicator of imminent volume spikes on specific Binance pairs
_candidate_servers_tier1.notes: Ephemeral — frequently banned and re-created. Named examples: Cryptic Pumps (discord.me/binance), USL Pump & Dump (discord.me/uslcryptopumpdump), Crypto Pump Whales (discord.me/cryptopumpwhales). Handle link rot gracefully.

_candidate_servers_tier2.name: Jacob's Crypto Clan
_candidate_servers_tier2.d2_relevance: High — altcoin micro-caps, presale pumps, early-stage tokens before Binance listing
_candidate_servers_tier2.notes: Jacob Crypto Bury (YouTube). Well-documented across review sites.

_candidate_servers_tier2.name: Cryptohub
_candidate_servers_tier2.d2_relevance: High — early token launch research, 15+ analysts, micro-cap chatter before volume spikes
_candidate_servers_tier2.notes: $15/mo premium. 30+ topic rooms. Confirmed across 5+ sources.

_candidate_servers_tier2.name: Elite Crypto Signals
_candidate_servers_tier2.d2_relevance: Medium-High — structured signal group, explains trade rationale. Less pump-oriented but high volume of altcoin signals

_candidate_servers_tier2.name: Binance Official
_candidate_servers_tier2.d2_relevance: Medium — new listing announcements reliably produce 100%+ spikes. Highest-signal single event type for pump detection
_candidate_servers_tier2.notes: Official server. Not a pump group — monitoring value is listing announcements and market sentiment.

_candidate_servers_tier3.name: r/CryptoCurrency Discord
_candidate_servers_tier3.d2_relevance: Medium — broad sentiment barometer, not signal-focused
_candidate_servers_tier3.notes: Official Discord of largest crypto subreddit (4M+ members).

_candidate_servers_tier3.name: Crypto Banter Hub / The Whale Room
_candidate_servers_tier3.d2_relevance: Medium — larger-cap focus but automated whale-tracking alerts cover Binance pairs
_candidate_servers_tier3.notes: Kyle Doops / Crypto Banter YouTube. Whale Room premium requires Whop subscription. Free Banter Hub is the monitoring target.

_join_strategy.phase_1: Join Axion + Binance Official + 1-2 DISBOARD pump servers. These are the easiest to access and highest D2 relevance.
_join_strategy.phase_2: If Phase 1 shows signal value, expand to Jacob's Crypto Clan + Cryptohub + Elite Crypto Signals.
_join_strategy.notes: Invite links for pump servers are inherently unstable. Design for link rot. Most servers allow bots (bots are how they deliver signals). Read-only monitoring bot should not violate ToS in most cases.
